quotes.author: admin
quotes.text: Booked Baymingo for a relaxing girls night cruising on the intercostal and the experience was absolutely wonderful. Ingrid made sure everything went well before cruising away, The boat is very comfortable, the captain was pleasantly friendly and made us feel at ease. The sunset view was breathtaking. I would definitely rent from them again in the near future.

quotes.author: Chris Matyas
quotes.text: Rented a 3hr tour with Bamingo and our captain was Franco, let me tell you it was one of the best 3hrs my family has spent together! He was so professional, experienced and went the extra mile making sure my children from 22-5 all felt special in their own way. I literally couldn’t have asked for a better experience from start to finish! This is a must and I will definitely do it again, & gotta be Franco!!!

quotes.author: Yenia Alvarez
quotes.text: I 100% recommend the boat tour with Baymingo Boat. Captain Manny makes the trip very enjoyable; my family had a great time. We watched the sunset while listening to some of the area's history. Thanks Manny.

quotes.author: Andner Sanon
quotes.text: I highly recommend Baymingo to anyone looking for a fun and secure adventure at Fort Lauderdale Beach. Captain Franco B. is incredibly talented, funny, and truly goes above and beyond expectations.

quotes.author: Daniel Singer
quotes.text: What a wonderful experience we had! The staff was super accommodating and our captain super friendly, showing us around FLL bay. 10/10 recommend!

quotes.author: Catie Jones
quotes.text: I had the best time! Super cute boat & easy rental. Cannot wait to use this company again!!
